question: A simple pendulum has period $T$ in a stationary lift. If the lift accelerates upward at $\dfrac{g}{3}$, the period becomes
solution:
Effective gravity in the lift: $g_{eff} = g + \dfrac{g}{3} = \dfrac{4g}{3}$.
$$T' = T\sqrt{\frac{g}{g_{eff}}} = T\sqrt{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}T$$
